sources.title: Aster Harbor Systems — initial Q2 2026 release
sources.text:
Fictional issuer Aster Harbor Systems plc (ticker AHX; entity identifier FICT-AHS-001) manufactures marine control systems. This company is distinct from Aster Harbor Holdings Ltd (ticker AHH; identifier FICT-AHH-002).
This release was published on 15 July 2026. Q2 2026 means 1 April through 30 June 2026; H1 2026 means 1 January through 30 June 2026. Unless otherwise stated, amounts are consolidated and in USD millions.
Aster Harbor Systems reported Q2 2026 revenue of USD 120 million and operating profit of USD 12 million. H1 2026 operating profit was USD 18 million. Parent-only Q2 2026 operating profit was USD 3 million.
Maya Vale (person identifier FICT-MV-A) was appointed chief financial officer of Aster Harbor Systems effective 1 July 2026. No operating-profit forecast for 2027 was published in this release.

sources.title: Aster Harbor Systems — corrected Q2 2026 release
sources.text:

The reporting period Q2 2026 is 1 April through 30 June 2026; H1 2026 is 1 January through 30 June 2026. Amounts below are consolidated and in USD millions, except the explicitly labeled parent-only figure.
Corrected Q2 2026 operating profit is USD 9 million, replacing USD 12 million in the 15 July release. Corrected H1 2026 operating profit is USD 15 million, replacing USD 18 million. Q2 2026 revenue remains USD 120 million. Parent-only Q2 2026 operating profit remains USD 3 million.

sources.title: Independent Harbor Wire — unconfirmed Orion delay
sources.text:

This is a disputed schedule allegation, not a confirmed contract amendment. Harbor Wire is independent of the issuer and of the mirror publisher News Relay.

sources.title: Aster Harbor Systems — response to delay allegation
sources.text:
On 12 August 2026, Aster Harbor Systems plc (AHX; FICT-AHS-001) denied the alleged delay of its Orion Ferry contract and said planned delivery remains in calendar year 2027. The contracted total value remains USD 24 million.
The company statement does not independently resolve the 10 August Harbor Wire allegation of a 2028 delivery. No completed delivery, customer confirmation, or third-party verification is reported here.
